why.summary: Unified cross-platform link hub with clean multi-language retrieval, preview, AI summary, and cross-OS reminders; Freemium + BYOK model

ratings.rationale: Users save articles, tutorials, reels, and posts daily across phone and desktop but forget them or fail to search across fragmented bookmark tools.
Workarounds (browser bookmarks, chat Keep, generic notes, social Saved tabs) lack cross-device search in mixed charsets, rich preview, AI summary, and recurring reminders.

Model: Freemium + Unlimited BYOK. Value metric: built-in AI summaries/month and media storage capacity. Free tier: 50 built-in AI calls/mo + unlimited BYOK/custom. Pro hypothesis: 99-149 THB/mo (~$3/mo provisional) for expanded quota/storage. Clears provisional cost per active user cleanly when AI ceiling holds (EXP-002 to falsify).
Provisional 30-day gate proposed: >=30% Week-4 active save/retrieve/reminder retention among first 50 Thai tech prosumer beta testers (ASM-003, EXP-001); awaiting live beta confirmation.

openQuestions: Confirm final 30-day retention stop-or-continue threshold (>=30% W4 active reuse) before public beta launch.

who.summary: Beachhead locked: Thai Knowledge & Tech Prosumers switching between mobile and desktop; anti-persona excludes bulk video downloaders

ratings.rationale: Locked beachhead: Thai knowledge workers, software devs, and technical students saving cross-language articles/tutorials/clips across mobile & desktop.
Triggers: forgetting critical saved links/deadlines and losing context across languages. Objections: trusting data persistence (answered by REQ-001/REQ-004), privacy/BYOK (REQ-002), cost (DEC-005).

Rented channels identified (Thai Dev/Productivity Facebook groups, Discord servers, X/Twitter threads); owned beta waitlist/onboarding channel (REQ-005) and borrowed creator outreach planned in EXP-001.
Same individual prosumer buys and uses. Anti-persona (PERSONA-002): bulk video downloaders/piracy archivers and enterprise legal-discovery teams.

what.summary: Core loop & <=5 v1 MVP pillars locked; Part 1 Full Integrity Package scoped cleanly ahead of Part 2 Unfurl and Part 3 Reminders

ratings.rationale: Save URL (+ folder/tags/note/schedule) -> immediately persist in Postgres without waiting on unfurl -> decode clean multi-language metadata + configurable AI summary -> fast FTS+trigram search or cross-OS reminder trigger.

Bounded to <=5 v1 MVP pillars: (1) Lossless Save & Multi-language Data Capture, (2) Fast 4-field Search, (3) Cover-only Rich Preview <=5 imgs, (4) 3-Tier Configurable AI Summary, (5) Cross-OS Hybrid Reminders.

In Part 1: only DB+Auth+Encoding/Search/Ai-alignment (no Part 2 Unfurl Worker or Part 3 Push/Cron yet). In v1 overall: no video re-hosting, no Public Share discovery feeds, no Semantic pgvector, no Team workspaces (deferred v1.1).
Only a URL (plus optional note, folder, or reminder rule) is required; user notes save even if remote website metadata fetch fails.

which.summary: Fast stack (Supabase + FastAPI + Next.js/Expo/WXT) with 3-tier AI and Day-2 Web-first UI cut line

ratings.rationale: Fast stack: Web (Next.js) + Extension (WXT) + Mobile (Expo Android/iOS) over FastAPI modular monolith and Supabase. Mobile justified by OS Share Sheet & scheduled reminder notifications; Day-2 UI integration prioritizes Primary Web UI first.
Captures at point of discovery (Share Sheet / Extension / MCP) and delivers actionable reminders & multi-language search when returning to desk.
Handles iOS Pre-APNs 64-slot local notification sync constraint cleanly in DB, non-UTF-8 web pages (TIS-620/Windows-874/Shift_JIS), and zero-downtime DB fallback on offline/unfurl fail.
Clean module boundaries: Supabase (Auth/Postgres/Storage/pg_cron) <-> FastAPI (Database, Login, Ai, Unfurl, Reminders) <-> 3-Tier LLM (Gemini/Groq built-in, BYOK, Ollama/vLLM).

whether.summary: Provisional unit economics modeled at 100/1K/10K MAU ($0 beta start); critical JWT fix, multi-charset safety, and PDPA tasks mapped

ratings.rationale:
Provisional Unit Economics Table (USD/mo, verify live billing pages in TASK-002; paying conversion 5% @ ~$3.00/mo avg from ~99-149 THB Pro tier):
| Monthly active users | 100 (Beta) | 1,000 | 10,000 |
| Fixed infra (Supabase Free->$25 Pro) | $0 (Free) | $25 (Pro) | $50 (Pro+compute prov.) |
| Variable AI (50% use within 50/mo cap) | $0 (Free tier) | ~$15 (prov.) | ~$150 (prov.) |
| Variable Storage/Push (Cover <=120KB WebP) | $0 (Free) | ~$2 (prov.) | ~$25 (prov. / R2 switch) |
| Support hrs x cost (solo founder) | $0 | $0 | $50 (prov.) |
| Total cost | $0 | ~$42 | ~$275 |
| Revenue (5% paying x ~$3/mo) | $0-$15 | ~$150 | ~$1,500 |
| Provisional margin | $0 to +$15 | +$108 | +$1,225 |
Note: Free tier 50/mo cap prevents runaway LLM burn; BYOK drives variable AI cost to $0.

Identified & mapped: (1) unverified JWT & X-User-Id bypass in Ai/router.py, (2) legacy HTML charset mojibake via raw resp.text, (3) pg_trgm gap on description/note/ai_summary, (4) MCP create_item canonical/reminder schema drift.

Jurisdiction: Thailand PDPA primary; EU/UK/California not yet targeted in beachhead (note explicitly). Data: email/auth, saved URLs, private notes, API token hashes, push tokens, optional BYOK headers (stateless). Security REQ-002 enforces JWT sig + dev-only bypass. Investigation tasks (TASK-001) + scraping/LLM risks (RISK-003) tracked with owner & launch gate.

Explicitly covers EDGE-001 (multi-charset/NFC/full text), EDGE-002 (iOS 64-slot local notification sync), EDGE-003 (canonical URL dedup & non-loss DB save on unfurl fail), EDGE-004 (quota/auth expiry).

when.summary: AI-accelerated sprint targeting Backend Part 1-3 today & UI live test tomorrow, protected by per-part gates & Primary Web UI cut line

ratings.rationale: Human operator directing full-cycle AI engineering (Claudy + deterministic test gates) in a dedicated sprint today (backend) and tomorrow (UI integration).
backend/Ai/ and backend/tests/test_ai_module.py exist and pass 10/10 tests (verified baseline), providing proven template for Parts 1-3.

Aggressive 2-day sprint (Day 1 = Backend Part 1 -> Part 2 -> Part 3 with offline SQL + Pytest gates; Day 2 = Live UI & Cloud integration). Tight schedule carries multi-client UI compression risk (RISK-004) without buffer.

Clear sequential cut line: Part 1 DB+Auth -> Part 2 Unfurl -> Part 3 Reminders must pass tests independently before next part starts; Day-2 real test verifies Primary Web UI + API end-to-end first, then Mobile Expo reminder sync, deferring Browser Extension polish if Day-2 runs late.

personas.title: Thai Knowledge & Tech Prosumer Switching Mobile <-> Desktop
personas.situation: Saves mixed Thai/English/Japanese articles, code docs, tutorials, and social posts daily across phone and computer, losing track across disconnected bookmark folders and chat Keep.
personas.outcome: Capture links cleanly in full text across any language, preview fast, summarize in chosen language with BYOK option, and get cross-OS scheduled reminders that never drop.
personas.workaround: Browser bookmarks, LINE Keep, IG Saved, Notion tables
personas.trigger: Missing a deadline on a saved post or wasting time hunting for a Thai/English link across apps.
objections: Data loss or truncated descriptions when sites break or change
Privacy of saved URLs/notes and locked-in AI subscriptions
Reliability of reminders across Android, Web, and pre-APNs iOS
channels: Owned: In-app onboarding & beta waitlist landing form (REQ-005)
Rented: Thai Dev / Productivity Facebook Groups, Discord servers, X/Twitter threads
Borrowed: Thai tech newsletter / dev creator demos (post-MVP beta)
personas.firstValue: Save any Thai/English URL -> full clean preview title/description stored immediately -> trigger configurable AI summary + recurring reminder synced across devices.
personas.positioning: For Thai knowledge workers & tech prosumers who save mixed-language links across mobile and desktop only to lose them, Just-Save-It is a cross-OS link-knowledge hub that preserves full readable metadata, AI summaries (BYOK-ready), and recurring reminders across devices. Unlike plain bookmarks or chat Keep, it guarantees multi-language text fidelity, visual previews, and proactive reminders.

personas.title: Bulk Video Downloader / Piracy Archiver / Enterprise Compliance Team
personas.reason: Product rejects video re-hosting, DRM/paywall circumvention scraping, and enterprise legal compliance archiving.

edges.title: Non-UTF-8 / legacy charset & multi-language text mojibake or truncation
edges.frequency: frequent on Thai (TIS-620/Windows-874), Japanese (Shift_JIS), and Chinese websites
edges.impact: Garbled titles/descriptions, lost Thai tone marks, failed search matches, unreadable previews
edges.response: Detect encoding via HTTP Content-Type -> HTML <meta charset> -> charset-normalizer, unescape HTML entities, normalize Unicode NFC without stripping combining marks, store lossless full-length TEXT, and index across all 4 fields.
edges.test: Given HTML bytes encoded in TIS-620, Windows-874, Shift_JIS, or UTF-8 with Thai tone marks, CJK, RTL, and emoji, when processed and saved, then DB stores lossless readable UTF-8 NFC text searchable via FTS and trigram.

edges.title: iOS Pre-APNs 64-slot local notification cap and cross-OS schedule drift
edges.frequency: every iOS user with cross-device or recurring reminders
edges.impact: Reminders created on Web/Extension fail to trigger on iOS if un-synced or >64 local slots
edges.response: Persist canonical once/every_n_days schedule with IANA timezone in Supabase reminders table; push Android/Web via FCM/WebPush; provide atomic claim RPC + iOS local-sync unrolling endpoint.
edges.test: Given an every_n_days reminder created on desktop Web, when claimed by backend RPC or synced by iOS device endpoint, remind_at advances deterministically by exact repeat_every_days in user timezone.

edges.title: Unfurl failure or tracking-parameter duplicate URLs risking data loss
edges.frequency: frequent across social shares (utm_, fbclid, igsh) and rate-limited sites
edges.impact: User loses saved link/notes if save depends on live HTTP unfurl, or creates duplicate items
edges.response: Persist user item, folder, tags, and note to DB immediately with enrich_status='pending' even when HTTP fetch fails; canonicalize URL and normalize url_hash via DB trigger + Python helper.
edges.test: Given an unreachable URL saved with user note and tags, when created via API or MCP, then item and user note persist cleanly with enrich_status='pending' and duplicate utm_ variants map to identical canonical url_hash.

edges.title: Built-in AI free quota exhaustion (50/mo) or spoofed/expired auth headers
edges.frequency: active users hitting free limit or unauthenticated API calls
edges.impact: Unexpected API failures or unauthorized cross-tenant access if X-User-Id bypass stays open
edges.response: Enforce Supabase JWT signature verification via backend/Login dependency; gate X-User-Id behind ENV=development and ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=true; surface remaining quota and seamless BYOK fallback.
edges.test: Given production environment settings, when request sends X-User-Id without valid signed Bearer JWT, then FastAPI returns HTTP 401.

decisions.title: Fast Stack: Supabase + FastAPI Modular Monolith + Expo/Next.js/WXT
decisions.rationale: Fast stack: Supabase Free->Pro + FastAPI (Database, Login, Ai, Unfurl, Reminders) + Next.js/Expo/WXT minimizes upfront $0 burn and leverages existing Ai/ codebase. Scale stack alternative: dedicated PgBouncer/workers + Cloudflare R2 CDN + APNs push service. Switch when: DB >400MB or egress >80% free limit or >500 paying users (provisional triggers).
alternatives: Scale-first microservices + self-hosted Postgres/Redis: rejected for 2-day sprint overhead
Pure serverless Next.js only without Python backend: rejected because existing Ai/ & trafilatura ecosystem are Python

decisions.title: Rich Preview Storage Cap: Cover-only WebP (<=800px/<120KB) + <=5 images + official embeds
decisions.rationale: Compressing only cover thumbnail to Supabase Storage and referencing indices 1..4 via external URL keeps storage cost negligible at 100-10K users.
alternatives: Re-host all carousel images or videos: rejected due to egress cost and copyright risk

decisions.title: Hybrid Reminders (once & every_n_days) with iOS pre-APNs local sync fallback
decisions.rationale: Delivers cross-OS reminders immediately without $99/yr Apple Developer gate during MVP test phase, cleanly upgradeable to APNs later.
alternatives: Require Apple Developer APNs from Day 1: deferred until post-beta public iOS release

decisions.title: Sequential Part 1 -> Part 2 -> Part 3 Backend Sprint + Day-2 Web-first UI Cut Line
decisions.rationale: Part 1 (DB + Auth + Integrity) locks contracts first, followed sequentially by Part 2 (Unfurl) and Part 3 (Reminders) today, then Day-2 live UI starting with Primary Web UI before Mobile Expo Local Sync and Browser Extension.
alternatives: Parallelize ungrounded frontend & backend changes across all 3 clients simultaneously: rejected for regression risk

decisions.title: Monetization Model: Price by AI Quota & Cloud Capacity (Freemium Free 50 AI/mo + BYOK + Pro ~99-149 THB/mo)
decisions.rationale: Model: Freemium + Unlimited BYOK. Value metric: monthly built-in AI summaries & cloud thumbnail storage. Tiers: Free (unlimited links/reminders + 50 built-in AI/mo + unlimited BYOK, 0 THB), Pro (~99-149 THB/mo provisional for higher AI quota/media/export extras). Why this model over alternatives: aligns variable LLM cost directly to quota without gating core bookmarking behind paywall. Clears provisional cost per active user by +$108/mo at 1K MAU assuming 5% conversion (EXP-002 tests).
alternatives: Pure flat paywall with no free tier: rejected because bookmarking switching friction demands try-before-buy
Pure usage-based billing per link: rejected for bill-shock anxiety
Per-seat B2B pricing: rejected because beachhead is individual prosumer

decisions.title: Part 1 Full Integrity Package & Configurable AI Language
decisions.rationale: Combines 11-table Postgres schema + RLS + accept_invite + 4-field FTS/pg_trgm search + multi-charset/NFC text hygiene + JWT security fix + configurable summary_language (default th) + backward-compatible backend/Ai alignment.
alternatives: Schema-only Part 1 leaving JWT bypass & encoding fixes until later: rejected by user in Focus Mode Round 1 & 2

requirements.title: 11-table Supabase Postgres schema, RLS policies, canonical triggers, accept_invite RPC, atomic claim_due_reminders RPC, and FastAPI CRUD API
Shared Supabase JWT signature verification (backend/Login/) and strict ENV=development + ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS gating for X-User-Id
Multi-charset HTML detection (UTF-8/TIS-620/Windows-874/Shift_JIS/GBK), Unicode NFC normalization preserving tone marks, lossless full title/description TEXT, and 4-field FTS+trigram search
Immediate DB persistence of link + user folder/tags/note regardless of unfurl status, plus configurable AI summary_language (default th) preserving summary_th compatibility
Owned waitlist/feedback capture channel and visible per-account Free AI quota indicator before hitting 50/mo cap

risks.title: CRITICAL: backend/Ai/router.py currently accepts unverified X-User-Id bypass and decodes JWT without verifying signature
Provisional unit economics margin depends on staying inside free/low-cost LLM quotas and >=5% Pro conversion once >1K MAU
Legal/Privacy: Thailand PDPA consent/deletion flow, EU/UK out-of-scope note, third-party scraping ToS, and Gemini/Groq data retention terms unchecked
2-Day Sprint Compression Risk: completing Backend Part 1-3 today + multi-client UI testing tomorrow without cutting Extension/Mobile scope could compromise quality

assumptions.title: Pro price hypothesis (~99-149 THB/mo) converts >=5% of frequent beta savers needing expanded AI quota
Built-in AI free tier (50 calls/mo cap) averages <=25 calls/MAU (~$0.015-$0.03 provisional variable cost/user when paid)
Provisional 30-day success KPI: >=30% Week-4 retention on core save/retrieve/reminder loop among first 50 beta users
AI-accelerated execution completes Part 1 -> Part 2 -> Part 3 offline-verified today under sequential Pytest gates

experiments.title: Beta Activation & Week-4 Reuse Test with 50 Thai Knowledge/Tech Prosumers
experiments.hypothesis: If we recruit 50 Thai Dev/Productivity users from Facebook/Discord communities to save >=5 mixed-language links with >=1 reminder, then >=30% (provisional) will actively retrieve or complete a reminder in Week 4 because clean preview + cross-OS reminders solve bookmark amnesia.
experiments.measure: Share of activated testers completing >=1 search/open/reminder trigger in Week 4 (provisional >=30% threshold; zero data loss as guardrail).
experiments.timebox: First 50 beta sign-ups or 30 calendar days post-UI beta open
experiments.decisionRule: >=30% W4 active reuse -> proceed to v1.1 (Public Share/Semantic Search); <15% -> re-interview churned testers and pivot beachhead or reminder UX before adding features.

experiments.title: Pro Tier Value Metric & Price Sensitivity Test (99-149 THB/mo)
experiments.hypothesis: If active Free users approaching 50 built-in AI calls/mo see BYOK (free) alongside a Pro tier (~99-149 THB/mo provisional), then >=5% click Upgrade intent / pre-register within 14 days because convenience beats configuring API keys.
experiments.measure: Pro upgrade intent click rate among quota-hit users over 14 days (guardrail: Free core save retention does not drop).
experiments.timebox: 14 days after beta reaches 50 active users
experiments.decisionRule: >=5% upgrade intent -> implement Stripe/PromptPay checkout at tested THB price; <2% -> stay BYOK-first or test lower price/annual bundle before building billing.
